_source.field_release_notes:
IQ Gateway software version 8.3.5058 supports grid-forming and grid-tied systems with
IQ8 Series Microinverters, IQ7 Series Microinverters, and third-party string inverters, along with
IQ Battery 3T/10T or IQ Battery 5P or IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.

  • Countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg, France, The Netherlands, Belgium,
    Poland, Spain, Portugal, Croatia, and Slovenia

    #FeatureDescription
    1Bug fixes
    • Fixes the issue of collapsing off-grid systems at a higher
      State of Charge (SoC) in the case of IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase sites.
    • Fixes the issue of limited power production in Grid Interconnection
      Capability (GIC) in the Power Export Limit (PEL) enabled sites.
  • Gateways supported:
    • IQ Gateway Metered
  • Microinverters supported
    • IQ8 Series, IQ7 Series, M Series, and third-party string inverters
  • Batteries supported
    • IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase
    • IQ Battery 5P
  • System controllers supported:
    • IQ System Controller 3 INT
  • Supported system configurations:
    • Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg, France, The Netherlands, Poland, Spain,
      Portugal, Croatia, and Slovenia
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with IQ8 Series Microinverters,
        IQ Gateway Metered, and IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with IQ7 Series Microinverters,
        IQ Gateway Metered, and IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with M Series Microinverters and/or
        IQ7 Series Microinverters, IQ Gateway Metered, and
        IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with compatible third-party string inverters,
        IQ Gateway Metered, and IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
      • Grid-agnostic solar and storage systems with IQ8 Series Microinverters,
        IQ System Controller 3 INT, and IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
      • Grid-forming (with backup) solar and storage systems with
        IQ7 Series Microinverters, IQ System Controller 3 INT and
        IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
      • Grid-forming (with backup) solar and storage systems with M Series Microinverters
        and/or IQ7 Series Microinverters, IQ System Controller 3 INT, and
        IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
      • Grid-forming (with backup) solar and storage systems with compatible third-party
        string inverters, IQ System Controller 3 INT, and IQ Battery 5P with FlexPhase.
    • France, The Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with IQ8 Series Microinverters,
        IQ Gateway Metered, and IQ Battery 5P.
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with IQ7 Series Microinverters,
        IQ Gateway Metered, and IQ Battery 5P.
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with M Series Microinverters and/or
        IQ7 Series Microinverters, IQ Gateway Metered, and IQ Battery 5P.
      • Grid-tied solar and storage systems with compatible third-party string inverters,
        IQ Gateway Metered, and IQ Battery 5P.
      • Grid-forming (with backup) solar and storage systems with
        IQ8 Series Microinverters, IQ System Controller 3 INT, and IQ Battery 5P.
      • Grid-forming (with backup) solar and storage systems with IQ7 Series Microinverters,
        IQ System Controller 3 INT, and IQ Battery 5P.
      • Grid-forming (with backup) solar and storage systems with M Series Microinverters
        and/or IQ7 Series Microinverters, IQ System Controller 3 INT, and IQ Battery 5P.
      • Grid-forming (with backup) solar and storage systems with compatible third-party
        string inverters, IQ System Controller 3 INT, and IQ Battery 5P.
